protocol: Nested subgroup of six from Connolly 2023. Three same-day ascents in the parent Phase 2 sequence. The study reports aircraft-simulated dispatch activity and day-before/day-after MRI.
outcome_window: Research MRI on the day after exposure.
locator: Abstract p. 733, Methods p. 734 and Results
note: Observed imaging endpoint. The MRI subgroup reuses the parent trial and supplies no new assessment of clinical DCS.

protocol: The RAF dispatcher was exposed aboard a C-130 during repeated jump training. The author reports 40 minutes depressurized at 25,000 ft and oxygen during offloading. Exact prebreathe duration and prior profiles are unavailable.
outcome_window: Symptoms described shortly after landing. Resolution after TT6. On reassessment the following day the patient reported poor recall of the events.
note: Confirmed as a published case report. Event date or sortie identifiers unavailable, so unique membership relative to the 2017 reports is unresolved.

protocol: Army Flight Surgeon Course Type IV chamber protocol. The source describes rapid decompression from ground level to 25,000 ft. Pressure time course and gas delivery unavailable.
outcome_window: Discussion places wrist pain the evening of training and presentation the next afternoon. The Case Presentation summarizes symptoms as developing the following day.
note: Dates and exact elapsed onset unknown. Bilateral wrist pain and anterior elbow paresthesia. Symptoms resolved after TT6; TT5 was administered the following day.
